objective: Populate the body-architecture recognition benchmark with real evidence-backed release cases while preventing label leakage.

split_strategy.rationale: Keep each source character corpus in exactly one split so the same character family cannot leak across benchmark partitions. Maker and architecture overlap is allowed to test architecture recognition across characters.
split_strategy.training_rule: Validation and test cases are evaluation-only. Do not train on audit metadata or release identifiers from any split.

scoring_policy.core: Canonical or strong evidence-backed architecture targets.
scoring_policy.provisional: Specific architecture-family targets retained for separate scoring because metrology/mechanical validation remains incomplete.
scoring_policy.open_set: Unresolved or umbrella architecture labels must be rejected as unknown rather than coerced into a known class.
scoring_policy.aggregate_rule: Report core, provisional, and open-set metrics separately; do not hide uncertainty in one aggregate score.

input_policy.current_asset_state: Every benchmark case has an exact source-backed image URL and verified SHA-256/size/type metadata. Raw image bytes are not stored in Git and local materialized asset IDs remain pending.
input_policy.next_step: Validate canonical-view identity/quality against the verified media, materialize locally only where needed for evaluation, then add low-resolution/occlusion/detached-component variants without changing ground-truth groups.

leakage_guard.note: Release/maker/character metadata is audit-only. Model input must be image/mesh-derived evidence.
